extension.summary: Different screensavers at different times of day
extension.description: Pick a screensaver for up to six time windows, such as a clock in the morning, a world map in the day and Black at night, plus a default for the rest of the day. Lists the screensavers you have installed. At each window boundary it sets Kodi's screensaver and restarts one that is already running, so the change shows at once. Windows can cross midnight. Open it from Programs to see what is scheduled now.
